question: According to IQAir's World Air Quality Report released in March 2025, which place in Meghalaya is the most polluted globally?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Byrnihat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **IQAir** is a Swiss-based air quality technology company that specializes in **real-time air quality data** and solutions to combat pollution.
 
• Exposure to **PM2.5** can cause serious health problems such as **asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)**, and heart conditions.
 
• **Byrnihat** is located on the border between **Meghalaya and Assam**, making it a hub for industrial activities, including the manufacturing of cement, steel, and other goods.
 
• The **World Health Organization (WHO)** has set a safe limit for **PM2.5** concentration at **5 µg/m³ annually**. Anything above this is considered harmful to human health.
 
• Authorities can implement stricter **emission standards** for industries and promote the use of cleaner technologies.
 
• Plantation drives and the creation of **green belts** around industrial areas like Byrnihat can help absorb pollutants.
